name: docsend-alternatives-guide
description: Open-source comparison matrix, feature benchmark, and TCO calculator evaluating DocSend alternatives and modern virtual data rooms in 2026.

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{const f=req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.slice(1);const p=path.join(__dirname,f);if(fs.existsSync(p)){res.writeHead(200);fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res);}else{res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not found');}}).listen(8089,()=>console.log('DocSend alternatives guide running at http://localhost:8089'));"

author: SendNow Open Source Team <opensource@sendnow.live>
